card.name: Citation and author-name punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words inside bibliographic citations and author credentials, such as the period after an initial, the colon after a journal title, or a title word before a publisher. Appears in reference lists and bylines on general web text.

modes.label: Initials and credentials
modes.description: The period after a single capital initial in an author name or after degree letters like P.

modes.label: Journal and title breaks
modes.description: A colon or title word inside a cited journal or book title just before the next part of the reference.
modes.example: The Asia Pacific Journal<<:>> Japan Focus.
